summary: iter269 Sprint 2 Philosophy Linkage validation: K4 incident-context-block split, K6 coaching strip, K7 domain breadcrumb, and K5 guidance article rewrite. API + EN flows fully PASS. ES toggle code path is correct per code review but my Playwright toggle interaction did not flip language in the live preview (likely a selector hit on the already-active EN button rather than the ES side of the LangToggle — pre-existing UI, not Sprint-2 code). Code review of all 4 listed files is clean and aligned with the philosophy linkage spec.
action_items: Main agent: ES toggle live-verify recommended — confirm that clicking ES in the LangToggle (next to EN in the NewMeeting header) flips meeting-coaching-strip to ES copy, incident-context-block header to 'PATRÓN REAL · lo que suele pasar', and meeting-domain-breadcrumb to 'DOMINIO Excavación'. Code path is correct (composeIncidentScaffold uses lang === 'es'; getDomainLabel(domain, lang) renders bilingual). iter267 already validated i18n end-to-end, so this is sanity only.

Optional: submit a meeting with the trenching_shoring scaffold loaded and open ViewMeeting to visually confirm record-discussion-block / record-incident-context / record-discussion-bullets render in the saved record (code review confirms wiring is correct in ViewMeeting.jsx lines 278-310).
critical_code_review_comments: splitIncidentScaffold.js: clean, well-commented, handles freeform fallback (returns bullets only when no header detected) — symmetric with composeIncidentScaffold output. No issues.
NewMeeting.jsx K6 coaching strip uses border-l-2 border-red-200 pl-3 — visually attached to the topic picker block, reads as foreman instruction not LMS copy. Tone is operational, not corporate.
NewMeeting.jsx K7 breadcrumb is correctly gated by `templateKey !== CUSTOM_TOPIC_KEY && tpl?.domain` so Custom doesn't render it — matches spec.
ViewMeeting.jsx K4 split: if header+pattern parsed → renders record-incident-context block ABOVE record-discussion-bullets; if no header (freeform) → falls back to single KV. Clean visual hierarchy.

K5 article body is a structured list (not a flat string) — test scripts that expect plain string body should serialize to JSON before substring-checking (this report's API check did exactly that and PATRÓN REAL is present in body_es).
test_credentials: Not required — all surfaces tested are public.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 2 testids: meeting-coaching-strip, meeting-domain-breadcrumb, incident-context-block (NewMeeting); record-discussion-block, record-incident-context, record-discussion-bullets (ViewMeeting). TopicPicker UX nuance: when first opened, topic-picker-search appears but items only render after a search query or scroll — use page.fill('[data-testid="topic-picker-search"]', 'trench') BEFORE wait_for_selector on topic-picker-item-trenching_shoring. Direct click without search hits 0 items. LangToggle: clicking `button:has-text("ES")` did NOT reliably switch language in my run (possibly because both EN and ES are rendered as separate buttons and the selector matched a stale element); prefer the data-testid='lang-toggle-es' (if present) or the second of the two toggle buttons. Public API: GET /api/guidance/articles/public-toolbox-talks returns body as a STRUCTURED LIST not a string — assertions must json.dumps() it.
